warnings.message: Basis initialization: first COST is only a global phase; p=1 is a diagnostic baseline.

verification.reachability_scope: All cardinality/include/exclude supports retained; no certificate for the inequality-feasible transition graph.

rationale.decision: Selected edges E1_2 through E1_19 to connect the fixed qubit (0) to all other free qubits, enabling support selection via quantum exchange. These edges reflect the highest proxy-B RMS changes, indicating sensitivity to portfolio adjustments

All edges use beta group 1, balancing the number of connections against angle budget constraints. This group choice is based on the lowest RMS and highest correlation for the first few edges, suggesting consistent financial signal.

The selection does not consider the full set of quadratic terms or their numerical contrast. A different edge set with lower RMS but higher correlation might outperform if the proxy-B RMS is a poor indicator of actual allocated-F quality.

fitting_record.feasibility_scope: Empirical batch fractions, not population certification
